primitives.name: Launch Readiness Probe
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## T-24h (day before kickoff) ```bash npm run launch:ready ``` Reads `scripts/check-launch-readiness.mjs` — read-only, no secrets, probes the live production endpoints (`/api/health?strict=1`, `/api/ops/public-surface-truth`, the picks and proof APIs) plus the repo (cron config mirror, operator tasks, nflverse currency).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'ok': 'Boolean flag indicating system health status', 'strict': 'Parameter enforcing strict validation mode', 'checks': 'Array of system component statuses', 'capabilities': 'Array of service capability states'}
primitives.assumptions: All endpoints are accessible and return valid JSON responses under defined query parameters.
primitives.breakdown_regime: System fails if any component returns FAIL status during strict validation.

layer2.mapping: Maps live API responses to structured compliance metrics using binary logic kernels.
layer2.telemetry: Health endpoint responses with strict validation flags.

primitives.name: Settlement Capability Check
primitives.verbatim_quote: rns HTTP 200 with `ok: true` only when `?strict=1` is set AND the database + ingestion checks are `ok` AND the settlement capability is not `degraded`/`unavailable`.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'ok': 'Boolean flag indicating settlement readiness', 'database_status': 'Status of database ingestion checks', 'settlement_capability': 'Operational state of settlement engine'}
primitives.assumptions: Settlement engine must be fully functional and non-degraded to pass.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if settlement capability is degraded or unavailable.

layer2.mapping: Derives settlement readiness from underlying system health and capability states.
layer2.telemetry: Settlement engine status and capability flags.

primitives.name: Operator Task Verification
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## T-2h (final check before the slate goes live) ```bash npm run launch:ready node scripts/check-operator-tasks.mjs ``` `check-operator-tasks.mjs` re-parses `docs/ops/OPERATOR_TASKS.md` and prints, per task, either a real repo-verified verdict or `manual — see task text`.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'task_status': 'Verification result per task (repo-checked or manual)', 'repo_verdict': 'Boolean indicating whether task was verified against repository'}
primitives.assumptions: All tasks listed in OPERATOR_TASKS.md are either completed or marked as manual.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Task fails if any item shows 'UNVERIFIED' and has not been manually resolved.

layer2.mapping: Maps operator task completion to structured verification states.
layer2.telemetry: Per-task verification results from parsed markdown file.
